claims.statement: Graph-specific recurrent placement search uses actual runtime and asynchronous controller workers, avoiding optimal labels and a separate runtime predictor.
Policy minimizes expected square-root runtime; manual co-location reduces the operation search space, with failure penalties and successful-only updates after5000steps.
RNNLM and two-GPU Inception tie the fastest baseline; selected NMT and four-GPU Inception placements improve deployment speed, with12–27hour search cost separate.
All demonstrations optimize the same operation-to-device placement task with graph-specific searches; no unchanged policy across native combinatorial tasks is demonstrated.
